rule.name: EagerFallbackDoesIo
rule.message: The fallback argument of orElse, getOrDefault, requireNonNullElse, firstNonNull or Optional.or is evaluated before the call, whether or not it is needed. Here it calls (not a plain getter) a repository, EntityManager, MyBatis-Plus mapper, JdbcTemplate, RestTemplate, RestClient, HttpClient or messaging template, or a method that only throws, so the query, the save or the exception happens on every call, even when the value was present. Pass a supplier instead: optional.orElseGet(() -> repository.save(entity)), optional.orElseThrow(() -> new NotFoundException(id)), or map.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> client.fetch(k)). An exception fits a fallback that must run every time, which then belongs on its own line.

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $io := ('org.springframework.data.repository.Repository', 'jakarta.persistence.EntityManager', 'javax.persistence.EntityManager', 'org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcOperations', 'org.springframework.jdbc.core.namedparam.NamedParameterJdbcOperations', 'org.springframework.web.client.RestOperations', 'org.springframework.web.client.RestClient', 'java.net.http.HttpClient', 'org.springframework.kafka.core.KafkaOperations', 'org.springframework.jms.core.JmsOperations', 'org.springframework.amqp.core.AmqpTemplate', 'org.springframework.messaging.core.MessageSendingOperations', 'com.baomidou.mybatisplus.core.mapper.BaseMapper'), $throws := function($c) { $c/self::MethodCall[*[1][self::ArgumentList]] [some $m in ancestor::ClassBody[1]/MethodDeclaration[@Name = $c/@MethodName] [count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) = $c/ArgumentList/@Size] [Block[count(*) = 1][ThrowStatement]] satisfies not($m/ResultType/@Void = true())] } return //MethodCall[ pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.Optional#orElse(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.OptionalInt#orElse(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.OptionalLong#orElse(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.OptionalDouble#orElse(_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.Map#getOrDefault(_,_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.Objects#requireNonNullElse(_,_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('com.google.common.base.MoreObjects#firstNonNull(_,_)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('com.google.common.base.Optional#or(_)')] /ArgumentList/*[last()] [let $arg := . return exists(descendant-or-self::MethodCall [count(ancestor::LambdaExpression) = count($arg/ancestor::LambdaExpression)] [count(ancestor::ClassBody) = count($arg/ancestor::ClassBody)] [(not(ArgumentList/@Size = 0 and (matches(@MethodName, '^(get|is|has)([A-Z]|$)') or @MethodName = ('connectTimeout', 'executor', 'followRedirects', 'proxy', 'version', 'sslContext', 'sslParameters', 'authenticator', 'cookieHandler'))) and exists(*[1][not(self::TypeExpression or self::AmbiguousName)] [some $t in $io satisfies pmd-java:typeIs($t)])) or exists($throws(.))])]
